# Supabase Full-Stack Architecture & PostgreSQL RLS

Build scalable, secure full-stack applications leveraging Supabase and PostgreSQL Row Level Security.

## Key Principles & Invariants
- Enable Row Level Security (`ALTER TABLE x ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;`) on every table without exception.
- Create explicit `CREATE POLICY` statements for `SELECT`, `INSERT`, `UPDATE`, and `DELETE`.
- Index foreign keys and columns utilized in RLS `USING` and `WITH CHECK` clauses for sub-millisecond evaluation.
- Secure Edge Functions against unauthorized invocations using JWT validation.
